typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

value.description: Value that the given string {@link id} should be mapped to

title:
Provides value mappings for timeseries data points (as string -> number mapping) as metadata. Types mixin in this
are only expected to have id & value field populated and there should be no other field on the type

E.g. entity type MyExampleTimeseriesValueMapping mixes TimeseriesValueMapping

Load data containing id & value field indicating the value mapping
name: TimeseriesValueMapping
